name: EPIC 211471667
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 9.6 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,288 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.06 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,741 K at its surface.
